protocol.writeBoundary: Named public repository entrypoints and the vector adapter only. Excludes arbitrary raw SQL, plugins, external stores, and writes to shared projections owned by another lifecycle.
protocol.latency: Fresh file/connection cloned from initialized schema; same loaded process. Excludes schema, fixture, late write and oracle, including all writer guards. Includes cleanup plus optional verification. Cleanup-only and guarded-cleanup execute the identical timed cleanup path. Rotating arm order, no process or disk-cache cold-start claim.
protocol.oracle: Independent SQL observations of 8 logical stores, including exactly one scrubbed target tombstone, evidence across all target revisions, an allowlisted Outbox tombstone payload, and exact keep-row snapshots; not physical-page erasure or model behavior.
protocol.statistics: Linear interpolation at index (n-1)*p (Hyndman-Fan type 7). Descriptive local timing quantiles; no confidence intervals or iid correctness interpretation.
protocol.crashProbes: SIGKILL after two manual uncommitted SQL writes, or after production clean() commits; first probe tests a representative SQLite transaction, not interruption inside production clean().

limitations: Finite deterministic schedules, not exhaustive concurrency or model checking.
Named public repository entrypoints and the vector adapter only. Excludes arbitrary raw SQL, plugins, external stores, and writes to shared projections owned by another lifecycle.
Arms are component ablations, not measured competing frameworks.
Synthetic two-record fixture; no real model, semantic unlearning, cache, backup, or secure page erasure.
Omission mutations are deliberate research SQL, not normal product operations.
Two SIGKILL barriers probe selected committed/uncommitted boundaries, not general crash consistency.
Timing excludes writer guards; cleanup-only and guarded-cleanup have the identical timed path.
Timing samples are local descriptive measurements; correctness schedules are not iid statistical samples.
